ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels, with high-intensity regions concentrated on the distal lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions are solid black. High-contrast white patches are located at the far left and far right distal lobes. These white regions are heavily intersected by black vertical striations and mottling that radiate from the fluke center towards the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serration along the entire trailing edge with irregular, high-frequency peaks (3-5 pixels in amplitude). Serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the outer thirds of both lobes compared to the regions near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending towards the tips, transitioning into a slight convex curvature at the terminal points of the lateral lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixels (barnacles) are densely packed on the far lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical, high-contrast black linear marks (rake marks) cross through the white pigmented regions on both lobes, most prominently on the upper-left distal white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization and associated scarring on the extreme distal tips; multiple parallel vertical rake marks indicative of previous physical interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'bleeding' effect where black pigment extends in thin, vertical finger-like projections into the high-intensity white patches on the distal edges.
